dialogue_dev_lycus.greeting: Welcome to my stall, traveler! Lycus has the finest goods in Haven—durable lockpicks, healing draughts, and hearty rations.

root.text: Merchant Lycus gestures to his array of wares displayed upon fine cedar tables.

choices.label: Show me what you have for sale.
Any work for a wandering hero?
Your parcel reached the Watch Post.

node_browse.text: Inspect my goods freely! Everything is guaranteed genuine Haven quality.

node_quest.text: Take this sealed parcel to Captain Valerius at the Watch Post. Bring me word it arrived and I will pay you well.

node_paid.text: Delivered and signed for! Here is your fee, as promised. Haven needs more couriers like you.

node_rumour.text: Between friends? The Captain keeps the brass key to the High Vault on his own belt. Earn his trust and he might lend it; cross him and the Watch will hang you.

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Vault Key
addJournalKnowledge.text: Lycus says Captain Valerius carries the High Vault key. A trusted friend of the Watch might be given access.

dialogue_dev_captain.greeting: Halt and declare your business in Haven. The Watch keeps a sharp eye on all strangers.

root.text: Captain Valerius stands rigid in iron chainmail, eyeing you with professional scrutiny.

choices.label: I heard there is a bounty on wild boars.
The boar is dead. About that bounty...
Lycus sent this parcel for the Watch.
Any urgent matters for the Watch?
The apprentice is safe in Haven.
Has anyone breached the High Vault recently?
Could the Watch trust me with the High Vault key?

node_boar_bounty.text: Indeed. The bristle boars in the Whispering Woods have grown bold and aggressive. Bring one down and Haven will pay you in good silver.

node_vault_warning.text: The High Vault is sealed under strict Watch decree. Anyone caught tampering with the iron lock will face immediate execution. Do not test our patience.

node_boar_paid.text: So the beast is down? Good work. Haven pays its debts. Here is your bounty.

node_parcel.text: Ah, Lycus' delivery: lamp oil and bandages for the Watch. Tell him it arrived in good order.

node_rescue_brief.text: Beasts from the Obsidian Crags dragged off an apprentice artificer two nights ago. If they move the poor soul deeper, we'll never find them. Two days, no more. Go!

node_rescue_done.text: Alive and home! You have the thanks of the Watch, and its silver.

node_vault_trust.text: You have earned the Watch's trust. Take the key. Whatever you find in the vault, the town's share stays the town's.

dialogue_dev_elena.greeting: Greetings, traveler. If you have an eye for ancient history, pray lend your ear to my inquiry.

root.text: Elena adjusts her spectacles and unrolls a map of the Sunken Crypt.

choices.label: Tell me of this Sunstone you seek.
I will venture into the crypt for you.
Do you know anything about the old monoliths?

node_sunstone_lore.text: Centuries ago, Lord Karas drew down solar fire into a radiant amber stone. When his dynasty fell, he was entombed with it in the Sunken Crypt. I seek it to restore Haven's lost chronicles.

node_accept_sunstone.text: May the light guide your blade! The crypt lies southeast of Haven. Beware the guardian Karas; death has not dulled his steel.

choices.label: I will return with the relic.

node_complete_sunstone.text: Unbelievable! The true Radiant Sunstone! You have achieved what a dozen expeditions failed to accomplish. Take this scholarly purse with Haven's deepest gratitude!

node_monoliths.text: Weathered standing stones dot the Whispering Woods, carved with runes older than Haven. Copy an inscription for me if you pass one; there is no hurry.

dialogue_dev_bandit.greeting: Step lightly, traveler. These woods belong to those swift enough to take what they want.

root.text: Silas twirls a wicked hunting dagger between scarred knuckles.

choices.label: Stand down, or taste cold steel.
What do you know of the hidden grotto nearby?
You look like a man with a proposition.

node_threat.text: Big words for a stranger far from the safety of Haven's walls! Walk away while your purse is still in your belt.

node_grotto_hint.text: Follow the overgrown fern trail east until you hit the cliff. There's a colossal granite boulder blocking a cave. Move the stone, and you'll find where the ancients washed silver.

addJournalKnowledge.title: Silas' Clue to the Grotto
addJournalKnowledge.text: Silas mentioned a huge granite boulder in the woods sealing a subterranean silver cavern.

node_bargain.text: Sharp eyes. The Watch wants my head; Valerius most of all. Turn me in and be a hero, take my silver and forget you saw me... or help me put the Captain in the ground, and the Syndicate will remember you.

choices.label: You're coming with me to the Watch.
The Captain is in our way. I'm in.

node_arrest.text: Silas spits, but sees your blade and raises his hands. You march him to the Watch Post in irons.

node_bribe.text: A heavy purse lands in your palm. "We never met," Silas grins.

node_ally.text: "Ha! I knew it." Silas presses a Syndicate token into your hand. Word of your pact will not stay secret for long; the Watch will treat you as an enemy.
